learning_outcomes.text: To be able to numerically model engineering problems.
To be able to numerically solve equation roots.
To be able to apply numerical differentiation and integration topics to problems.

syllabus_topics: Definitions, Error, Taylor Series, Equation roots (closed methods, open methods), Taylor series related examples
Bisection method, examples related to the bisection method
False position method, examples related to the false position method
Simple fixed-point iteration method, examples related to the simple fixed-point iteration method
Newton-Raphson method, examples related to the Newton-Raphson method
Secant method, Modified Secant method, examples related to the Secant method
Gauss Elimination method, examples related to the Gauss Elimination method
LU decomposition method, examples related to the LU decomposition method
Nonlinear equation systems and their solutions using the Simple fixed-point iteration and Generalized Newton-Raphson method
Optimization, One-dimensional unconstrained optimization, Golden Section Search
Polynomial regression, examples related to polynomial regression
bibliography: Yazılım ve Programlama Uygulamalarıyla Mühendisler için Sayısal Yöntemler, Steven C. Chapra, Raymond P. Canale, 4. Basımdan çeviri, Hasan Heperkan, Uğur Kesgin, Literatür Yay. 2008.
Sayısal Yöntemler ve Matlab Uygulamaları, Nurhan Karaboğa, Nobel yay. 2. Bas. 2015
Pseudo Programlar İle Sayısal Analiz, Zekeriya Altaç, Dora Basım Yayın
